_comment: Pre-registered power sensitivity for P1. MDE is the minimum meaningful
paired improvement. The variance values are conservative ceilings: if a
model pilot observes larger paired-difference SD, N must be recomputed before the full run.

true_routers.rationale: 5 routers is about 9% of the broad-scenario B5 mean; SD 8 is above observed baseline SD.

aliased_waste_ratio.rationale: 5 percentage points is larger than the Stage 1 aliased-waste SD and above a 1% accounting floor.
